title: Battle of Mouzaki
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Mouzaki", at revision 1370450665, opens: "The Battle of Mouzaki occurred on 4 May 1878 between Greek irregulars with the cover support of the Greek Army against the Ottoman Army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871810, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1878 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
